install: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http sentry https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/{organizationSlug}/{projectSlug}
verify: Ask Claude Code to list the recent unresolved Sentry issues of the scoped project.
read_only_mitigation: The official page (https://mcp.sentry.dev/) lists no tool names and no read-only mode. Run /mcp, review the tool list, and allow only the read-only tools; use an account with the minimum role.
